articles.headline: iPhone 18 Pro Hits Stores Today. Apple Stock Could Rise 13% if Demand Sticks, Analyst Says.
articles.summary: Apple  took a risk by launching only premium priced phones in its latest rollout, but one Evercore ISI analyst thinks that risk will pay off for the company’s sales, and its stock.  Amit Daryanani raised his price target on Apple to $380 from $365 on Friday, which implies a 13% increase from the stock’s last closing price of $337.  This price target boost comes after Evercore completed an annual survey of about 4,000 customers regarding iPhone purchase intentions, which Daryanani says points to what he thinks will be a better-than-expected iPhone refresh cycle.
